comments.author: @AndreasMihardja-d3g
comments.text:
Bhutan has to change or the country will be empty and destroyed. The people has to be educated and informed what the world outside Bhutan is. They are now under the oppressive colonial regime of India and not permitted to connect with China or even Nepal. The people of Bhutan are indoctrinated India is their mother country. The Indian army is stationed as the colonial force inside Bhutan. We all know India is NOT a developed country at all esp. with this N. Modi government. They are living in the middle ages. This is the reality that Nepal experience and why they try to reach out to China. China is building communication from Tibet into Nepal - road and rails to avoid a blockade by India.
Remember Bhutan ask for a road into China that was approved by China and the result India destroyed the road and fight the Chinese roadworkers away. Bhutan king has to apologized to India for daring to ask China for help. We as outsiders just have to pity the Bhutan people.
In my personal opinion the royal family is the only power that still protect Bhutan. If there is no royalty Bhutan will be annexed by India like Sikkim [now a part of India]. Their policy is for the time the only policy to prevent Bhutan to become a country like India with Dalit at the bottom of the society.
